destinations.name: Manhyia Palace Museum
destinations.description: The official palace of the Asantehene, the King of the Ashanti people. The museum showcases the rich history and culture of the Ashanti Kingdom, including royal artifacts, traditional clothing, and historical exhibits.
destinations.entry_fee: GHS 20 for adults, GHS 10 for students
destinations.location_details: Located in Kumasi, capital of Ashanti Region. Easily accessible from the city center.

destinations.name: Kejetia Market
destinations.description: The largest open-air market in West Africa, Kejetia Market is a bustling commercial hub with over 11,000 stores selling everything from traditional crafts to modern goods.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: Morning (8 AM - 12 PM) for best experience
destinations.location_details: Central Kumasi, near Adum and the central business district.

destinations.name: Lake Bosumtwi
destinations.description: Ghana's only natural lake, formed in an ancient meteorite crater. Surrounded by lush forests and traditional fishing villages, it's a serene destination for nature lovers.
destinations.accessibility: Accessible by car, some hiking required
destinations.location_details: 30 km southeast of Kumasi. Accessible via road.

destinations.name: Okomfo Anokye Sword Site
destinations.description: A legendary site featuring a sword driven into the ground by the powerful priest Okomfo Anokye centuries ago. According to Ashanti tradition, if the sword is removed, the Ashanti Kingdom will fall.
destinations.location_details: Near Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital in Kumasi.

destinations.name: Asante Traditional Buildings (UNESCO)
destinations.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring traditional Ashanti architecture. These buildings showcase the unique construction techniques and cultural significance of Ashanti heritage.
destinations.location_details: Located in villages around Kumasi, including Asawase, Edweso, and Ejisu.

accommodations.name: Golden Tulip Kumasi City
accommodations.description: A modern 4-star hotel in the heart of Kumasi offering comfortable accommodations, excellent dining, and business facilities.
accommodations.additional_info: Located near Kejetia Market and major business districts.

accommodations.name: Four Villages Inn
accommodations.description: A boutique hotel offering a blend of traditional Ashanti hospitality and modern comfort. Located in a serene environment.
accommodations.additional_info: Peaceful location with easy access to major attractions.

accommodations.name: Lancaster Kumasi City Hotel
accommodations.description: A comfortable 3-star hotel offering good value for money with modern amenities and friendly service.
accommodations.additional_info: Central location, good for business and leisure travelers.

accommodations.name: Lake Bosumtwi Paradise Resort
accommodations.description: A lakeside resort offering stunning views of Lake Bosumtwi, perfect for a peaceful getaway in nature.
accommodations.additional_info: Perfect for nature lovers and those seeking tranquility.

accommodations.name: Miklin Hotel
accommodations.description: A well-established hotel in Kumasi offering comfortable rooms and good facilities at affordable rates.
accommodations.additional_info: Good value accommodation in central Kumasi.
